account_id.description: Account this task billed to. Present only when the client names the account outright: the host never guesses, so an absent value means the account is unknown rather than unset.

input_tokens.description: Complete input total, including cache-read tokens.

cache_read_tokens.description: Input tokens served from cache; cache hit rate is cache_read_tokens / input_tokens.

cache_write_tokens.description: Tokens written to cache (cache creation), kept separate from cache reads.

cost.description: Amount charged. Read cost_source to learn what this figure covers: one request, or the whole task.

cost_source.description: Where cost came from. relay-log: matched to a per-request record in a relay's billing log, so cost is that single request. balance-delta: the account balance drop observed across the whole task, used for official API accounts that publish no per-request billing; it is a real charge, but its granularity is the account refresh interval. client: reported by the client itself. Absent when no cost is known.

time_to_first_token_ms.description: Client-reported time to first token; omitted when unavailable.

details.description: Per-request breakdown, present when the client or a relay log supplies one. Only meaningful when cost_source is relay-log or absent; a balance-delta task has no per-request detail by construction.
